parameters.query: {{ "SELECT c.customer_id::text, c.full_name, c.created_at, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity),0) as total_spent FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.full_name ILIKE '%" + $('Webhook').first().json.body.customer_name + "%' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.full_name,c.created_at LIMIT 1" }}
